# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is the repository for my coursework project for Data Intensive Physics (unit code PHYSM0070) during my final year at the University of Bristol.

This project is working on using machine learning to identify anomalies in the Euclid Q1 dataset. This work has made use of the Euclid Q1 data from the *Euclid* mission of the European Space Agency (ESA), 2025, https://doi.org/10.57780/esa-2853f3b @aussel_euclid_2026 @mccracken_euclid_2026 @polenta_euclid_2026 @romelli_euclid_2026 @tucci_euclid_2026 @copin_euclid_2026 @brun_euclid_2026
